sentences.en: What do you enjoy doing in your free time?
sentences.ar: ماذا تستمتع بفعله في وقت فراغك؟

sentences.en: I like reading and photography.
I recently started learning to draw.
My favorite hobby is cycling.
I usually ride in the evening.
How did you get interested in that?
A friend introduced me to it.
I enjoy trying new activities.
I am not very good at it yet.
Practice makes it easier.
Do you prefer indoor or outdoor hobbies?
sentences.ar: هل تفضل الهوايات المنزلية أم الخارجية؟

sentences.en: I like being outdoors when the weather is nice.
sentences.ar: أحب الخروج عندما يكون الطقس جميلًا.

sentences.en: I sometimes play board games.
We meet once a week.
Music helps me relax.
I listen to many different genres.
Have you ever tried pottery?
sentences.ar: هل جربت صناعة الفخار من قبل؟

sentences.en: No, but I would love to.
I watched a tutorial online.
It looked easier than it was.
I learned something new today.
This hobby requires patience.
I am collecting ideas for a project.
Do you have any recommendations?
There is a workshop this weekend.
We could go together.
I need to buy a few supplies.
You can borrow mine.
That would be very helpful.
I like hobbies that challenge me.
It is fun to learn at my own pace.
sentences.ar: من الممتع التعلم بالوتيرة التي تناسبني.

sentences.en: I do not want to turn it into a job.
Sometimes I just need time for myself.
Having a hobby brings balance to life.
sentences.ar: وجود هواية يحقق التوازن في الحياة.

sections.heading: A new situation
